mapper.select: select va.id, va.room_id, va.appointment_time, va.appointment_status, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number, gi.name, gi.url from lease.view_appointment va left join lease.apartment_info ai on va.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.room_info ri on va.room_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.graph_info gi on gi.item_type = 1 and gi.item_id = ai.id and gi.is_deleted = 0 where va.is_deleted = 0 and va.user_id = #{userId} order by va.create_time desc
